title: Consistent viscoplastic algorithmic tangent
objective: Derive and implement the consistent algorithmic tangent for both Perzyna and Johnson-Cook return maps. Unlike rate-independent J2, the viscoplastic tangent includes the viscosity term and, for JC, the thermal coupling.
scope: Derive the algorithmic consistent tangent from the linearised return map for both models.
For Perzyna: add the viscosity term d(f)/d(dl) from the overstress law.
For Johnson-Cook: include the thermal-coupling Jacobian d(dl, dT) / d(E).
Verify against FD of the return-map stress update on random strain states.
implementation_steps: Rewrite each model's `radial_return` to return a `tangent` field in `ReturnMappingResult`.
Derive the tangent using implicit differentiation of the Newton residual at convergence (Simo & Hughes §3.4 extended).
Unit-test via FD of the stress update: central difference must agree with the analytical tangent to 1e-5.
Add major-symmetry check (C_IJKL == C_KLIJ) for both tangents.
acceptance_criteria: Perzyna tangent matches FD of the stress update to 1e-5 on 10 random strain states.
Johnson-Cook tangent matches FD to 1e-5 on 10 random states (including non-reference T).

cases: Perzyna FD tangent check (10 random states)
JC FD tangent check (10 random states)

risks: Getting the coupled (dl, dT) Jacobian wrong will silently degrade Newton convergence instead of producing obviously wrong stresses. Mitigation: FD test is the primary safeguard; always compare to central difference on random states before merging.

commands.command: uv run pytest test_j2 + test_perzyna + test_johnson_cook + test_symbolic_ir_interface + test_frontend_build_context

completion_notes: Shared `assemble_j2_like_tangent(lam, mu, S_dev_trial, sigma_eq_trial, dl, denominator)` factored at module scope in `j2_power_law.py`. J2's own `radial_return` now routes through the helper — byte-identical formula (verified by test_tangent_fd_plastic).

Perzyna tangent: denominator = 3*mu + H'(alpha_new) + eta_term, with eta_term = (eta/m) * (1/dt)^(1/m) * dl^(1/m - 1). At eta -> 0, eta_term -> 0 and the tangent reduces byte-for-byte to the rate-independent J2 tangent (unit-tested).

Johnson-Cook tangent: captures converged 2x2 Newton Jacobian J_conv, then Schur-complement reduction gives denominator = -det(J_conv)/J_conv[1,1]. Reduces byte-for-byte to J2 at beta=0, C=0, T=T_ref (unit-tested).
FD test harness aligned with J2 convention (`dE_sym`, central difference divided by 2*eps). An earlier draft divided by eps, giving exactly 2x the true derivative (50% rel err) — fixed before commit.
Major-symmetry tests added beyond the scaffold (AC-3). Elastic-branch sanity test ensures below-yield still returns elastic_tangent exactly.
No Taichi-emission changes required (Perzyna/JC printer emission remains a deferred integration task, consistent with P3-1/P3-2 wording).
